name: Voice app for controlling Claude Code / Codex sessions

mentions.name: Voice app for controlling Claude Code / Codex sessions
mentions.description: This voice app lets users control Claude Code and Codex sessions by voice. It can start a remote tmux session on a laptop; the user can then close the lid, put on AirPods, and continue the same sessions hands-free while at the gym or cycling. It is planned to be open sourced soon.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've built a voice app for controlling Claude code / Codex sessions and having a lot of fun with it.

I can start a remote tmux session from my laptop, close the lid, grab my airpods and continue on the same sessions while in a gym or a bicycle.
